name: bingley-skills
description: Free AI sales skills by Bingley — install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: cold-email-builder
plugins.description: Builds a cold email for you, or grades and rebuilds the one you have, on a rubric calibrated against real reply outcomes.

plugins.name: company-researcher
plugins.description: Researches companies — one or four thousand — into ranked cheat sheets: what they do, why now, the angle to use.

plugins.name: list-builder-apollo
plugins.description: End-to-end prospecting on a connected Apollo account. Every credit spend sits behind its own explicit confirm.

plugins.name: sales-advisory-board
plugins.description: Eight sales greats argue one real sales decision over two rounds and hand down a verdict — every quote verbatim and cited.

plugins.name: sales-control-panel
plugins.description: Reads any deals export and renders your desk: what to do in the next hour, and whether your pipeline can be trusted.

plugins.name: sales-brain-setup
plugins.description: Five-question onboarding that builds your AI sales brain, so every other Bingley skill wakes up knowing who you are.
